meta.title: MQCS to SAP PO Integration: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as the same-tenant user without the Buyer role and verify whether MQCS to SAP PO Integration is refused or absent.
Repeat the MQCS-to-SAP PO transfer as a Buyer and verify that it is available and succeeds.
Inspect or record the tenant's Enterprise plan and RBAC configuration, including whether access is deliberately granted to additional roles.

plan.title: MQCS to SAP PO Integration RBAC

steps.note: Open the Master QCS screen where the SAP PO integration action is expected to be available.

args.need: sign in as the same-tenant non-Buyer user and Buyer user, inspect and run MQCS to SAP PO Integration for each, and report whether the action is absent or refused for the non-Buyer and available for the Buyer

steps.note: The catalog cannot change user identities or observe the SAP PO integration action and its role-based result.
Confirm the Master QCS screen remains usable without an application error after the tester's investigation.
